study.title: Collaborative Wheat Lodging Segmentation Semi-Supervised Learning Model Based on RSE-BiSeNet Using UAV Imagery

segmentation.domain: crop (wheat lodging vs non-lodging vs background)

dataset.name: Self-built wheat lodging dataset (Lujiang County, Hefei, China)
dataset.note: DJI Phantom 3 Pro RGB (4000x3000 px), flight height 30 m, speed 3 m/s, heading overlap 70%, side overlap 75%; orthorectified/stiched (Pix4Dmapper), cropped to 256x256 patches; augmented (noise, mirror, rotation, blurring) 300 -> 1500 images; split 7:2:1 = 1050 train / 300 val / 150 test; classes: lodging, non-lodging, background (land, roads).

segmentation.backbone: ResNet-18 (context path, replacing Xception39) + SE attention

mIoU.quote: RSE-BiseNet F1-score reaches 93.1%, and mIoU reaches 89.2%
mIoU.section: 4.2 Comparison of wheat lodging segmentation results based on different models / Table 2
mIoU.ambiguity: RSE-BiSeNet with full (1200-image) labeled training: mIoU 0.892. Comparisons: U-Net 0.805, BiSeNet 0.840, DeepLabv3+ 0.867. Semi-supervised (50% labels = 600): mIoU 0.876.

F1.ambiguity: RSE-BiSeNet fully supervised F1 0.931 (precision 0.946, recall 0.912); semi-supervised 50%-labels F1 0.903; U-Net 0.883, BiSeNet 0.901, DeepLabv3+ 0.919.

PA.ambiguity: No overall accuracy reported; class-level precision (0.946) and recall (0.912) reported for RSE-BiSeNet.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Lodging-area F1 captured under F1; no crop/weed distinction.

issues: No efficiency/complexity or inference metrics reported (only accuracy metrics); no edge-relevant data.
Multiple F1/mIoU figures depending on learning scheme and label proportion; headline values from Table 2 (fully supervised RSE-BiSeNet) recorded.
